results.title: Love and Faith – Chica Xavier
results.overview: Chica Xavier’s life was shaped by love, axé, the performing arts, and education. Directed by her youngest son, this documentary offers an intimate portrait of the great Bahian actress, a daughter of Oyá whose life transformed countless others, both on and off screen, leaving behind a legacy of love.

results.title: Maria of Maria
results.overview: Brazil, 1940. Maria, a young outlaw, discovers she is pregnant; after her band is wiped out, she flees to the Center-West to give birth and start life anew. She joins Getúlio Vargas’s "March to the West" government program, which promised land to small farmers. In the first half of the story, Maria confronts untamed nature—discovering that farming is an art. In the second, her past comes back to haunt her, and she must summon her fiercest, most indomitable courage.

results.title: Who Is Martin Mull?
results.overview: Discover Martin Mull's restless reinvention from smoky folk clubs to primetime sitcoms to gallery walls, told in his own words and by the friends who watched it happen, including Steve Martin, Tom Waits, David Alan Grier and others.

results.title: Pentimento
results.overview: On an errand to the Hamptons, an artist’s assistant makes an embarrassing mistake that pressures him to face his creative stagnation.

results.title: First Five
results.overview: An unprecedented, intimate look at the five young men who served as Coach Bob Knight's very first recruiting class for the Indiana University basketball team from 1971 to 1975.

results.title: Reveal
results.overview: A hard drive found at an archaeological site in Méier—an old suburb of what was known as Rio de Janeiro—reveals previously unseen images of the preparations for a festive ritual celebrated during the Years of the Outbreak: the gender reveal party.

results.title: Honto ni Atta! Noroi no Video 118
results.original_title: ほんとにあった! 呪いのビデオ 118
results.overview: 118th installment of "Honto ni Atta! Noroi no Video," a film series that compiles paranormal videos submitted by the public.

results.title: New York Never Let Me Down
results.original_title: New York Never Let Me Down
results.overview: Charlotte Wells drops into the YWCA of the Greater Capital Region to visit Paula Spiro, a legendary drummer and drum teacher (whose former students include Luscious Jackson drummer and original Beastie Boy Kate Schellenbach). Having left New York in 2024, the elderly Spiro recalls her life in the city with wonderment and an unerring sense of rhythm, in a tribute to the artists and queer elders being pushed out of the place they shaped.

results.title: The House Call
results.overview: Called in the middle of the night to treat a sick horse, a young equine veterinarian is faced with a series of unlikely encounters.

results.title: Fan Out
results.overview: Chaos ensues when four university students accidentally submit fanfiction for a major assignment. What follows is an attempt to break into the lecturer's office and delete the file, a spontaneous mission which gradually spirals into mayhem.

results.title: Thicker Than Water
results.overview: Two estranged best friends find a way to reconnect after they discover a regenerative wine and begin testing its limits on each other.

results.title: She Said
results.overview: A migrant worker recounts a strange tale about her past when her boyfriend proposes to her.

results.title: While the Lights are on
results.overview: When Sofie starts to realize her life's dream may not be as easy as once thought, she looks back on her childhood and speaks to her friend as to rethink her passion and rest of her life.

results.title: Midnight Sun
results.overview: Surabaya is a bustling city, and this documentary captures a 24-hour cycle in the lives of three people whose lives have been shattered by circumstances beyond their control, yet who refuse to be victims.

results.title: Almari
results.overview: When a family discovers the enchanting powers of their old mysterious cupboard, their lives spiral into a web of desires, drawing both - foes and vices to their doorstep.
